research_question: On identical fresh identities and training budgets, does MFT-ISRJ label-conditional margin supervision outperform original BCE retraining and ordinary ISRJ hard-negative weighting for ultra-close MFT false-positive control without degrading twelve-parameter joint sensing?
seed_substitution_reason: The prompt-proposed 680M and 690M identities were already consumed by P4d and P4e in the authoritative workspace. P3n-A therefore uses unused 760M and 770M identities.

variants.B2_hard_negative: B1 plus weight 3.0 on ISRJ BCE for MFT=1 and ISRJ=0 samples
variants.B3_conditional_margin: B1 plus 0.1 times symmetric label-conditional MFT-ISRJ softplus margin loss with margin 1.0

training.threshold_calibration: per-class F1 grid 0.05:0.01:0.95 on calibration identities only
training.selection_role: diagnostic only; no hyperparameter change after development access

attribution_rules.B1_passes_and_B3_not_better: distribution coverage, not a new loss mechanism
attribution_rules.B2_equivalent_to_B3: ordinary hard-negative weighting is sufficient; conditional margin is not supported as the core innovation
attribution_rules.only_B3_passes: conditional cross-interference relation supervision receives mechanism support
attribution_rules.all_fail_but_oracle_separable: representation insufficiency; move to local delay-peak and periodic dual-view training
attribution_rules.oracle_not_separable: audit physical identifiability, generator contract and observation length

stop_rule: Do not change data roles, losses, weights, margin, training budget, thresholds procedure or gates after opening seed770000000 development predictions. If P3n-A fails, freeze 770M and follow the preregistered attribution rule on new identities.
